releaseNotes: Google, Microsoft, Facebook and Apple sign-in now reliably return you to the app on every platform — the sign-in token reaches Sonora instead of being consumed by the browser tab
Android sign-in handoff fixed — Chrome no longer silently blocks the return to the app; a one-tap 'Open Sonora' button is shown as a fallback
Desktop fullscreen support — press F11 or use the toggle in the top bar for true OS-level fullscreen

Offline download integrity — on startup, every downloaded track is verified against its stored audio; if the OS evicted a track's bytes under storage pressure, it's cleanly removed instead of falsely showing as available offline
Download resume no longer corrupts files — if a server ignores a resume request and sends the whole file, the download restarts cleanly instead of stitching a broken file together
Sign-in state survives Android suspending the app while the browser is open — the handoff no longer fails its security check

Auto-update reliability overhaul — a release is now published only after both the Windows installer and Android APK build successfully, so a failed build can never leave a partial release that breaks auto-update for the other platform
Desktop updater stays on the stable channel — it no longer picks up pre-release builds, so your installs only move to final, published releases
The 'Restart & install' button now uses the safe download-then-install path, so it never fails even if the background auto-download hasn't finished yet
Music data keeps flowing even when Base44 integration credits are exhausted — all track, artist, and chart requests route through the independent Cloudflare Worker proxy, separate from the billing
Crash isolation at app, route, and section level — a single broken component never takes down the whole app, and a retry is always one click away
